prior_art.edition: Printed: Gardiner, Hamilton Papers (Camden 1880), italic decipherments from no. 91 (4 Jan 1648) on; NRS notes 2213 at pp. 152-3 and 2214 at pp. 151-2. 1250.closed: Part of this row is deciphered on record: 2212, 2213, 2214, 2227 are marked deciphered, with 2213 and 2214 printed in Camden 1880 pp. 151-3 and 2212, 2227 summarised in HMC 1887 p. 119. SPLIT NEEDED: no reading found for the Charles I group 2183 (18 Dec 1647), 2184 (17 Jan), 2186 (17 Dec 1647), 2188 (2 Jan), 2190 (29 Jan, 3 items), nor for 2216 and 2223; these look like a separate lead, not yet vetted as open. Compare first: 2193 (25 Mar 1648) with HMC 1887 no. 299 of the same date '[Deciphered, not printed]'; 2218 (15 Feb) with HMC no. 278 of the same date 'only partially deciphered'; 2215 is HMC no. 274, summarised from its clear postscript.
